paragraphs.text: One-shot OMP subagent provider for DeepSeek Harness: delegate tasks to your locally installed omp ag
ent, serialized one at a time
# dsh-subagent-omp

DeepSeek Harness plugin: delegate one task at a time to your locally installed
OMP (oh-my-pi) agent.

The spawned `omp`
child runs with **its own `~/.omp` configuration** — its provider, model
bindings

, MCP servers, and approval settings are whatever your OMP
installation already has. This plugin nev
er configures or overrides them.

The plugin icon is adapted from the Oh My Pi project logo
(`assets/icon.svg`, MIT, © Mario Zechner,
Can Bölük, Stencil Labs, Inc.).
## What it does

- Registers a one-shot subagent provider (`omp`) in the DSH agent-team seam.
- Exposes one model-fac

ing tool, `subagent_omp`, alongside the built-in
`subagent` / `subagent_fork` tools. When the OMP bu

ndle is enabled, the model
can hand a self-contained task to your local OMP installation and get its

final answer back.
- Spawns `omp --print --mode json --no-session` per delegation, feeds the task
t

hrough stdin, and selects the final answer from the JSONL `agent_end` event.
- **Serializes** delega

tions: one OMP child at a time, in submission order.
Necessary for single-session local model engine

s (a llama.cpp-style server
serves one request at a time); harmless for cloud-backed OMP setups.
- O

ne-shot semantics, mirroring the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`
and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-su

bagent-claude-code` bundles: the child cannot receive
follow-up messages, and the run leaves no OMP

de` bundles: the child cannot receive
follow-up messages, and the run leaves no OMP session on disk.
## When to use it

Install this Profile Bundle when a delegated task should run as a fresh,
unattended OMP session in t

he parent Session's workspace — typically to spend a
local or differently-metered model instead of t

he harness's own LLM route.
Each delegation uses one self-contained text task and returns only the s

elected
answer or a safe failure diagnostic. Native OMP configuration and
authentication remain auth

oritative. Choose it when running on the OMP
runtime's own model matters more than continuation or h

it when running on the OMP
runtime's own model matters more than continuation or harness-side tools.

Routing between the sibling delegation tools is the model's choice at call
time; the tool descriptio

n carries the same one-shot wording as the official
product providers, so a delegation goes to OMP w

hen the user names it, or when
the model judges an offload suitable for the OMP runtime. There is no

automatic catch-all: `subagent` (in-process), `subagent_fork`
(context-inheriting), and `subagent_o

mp` coexist and none of them claims
another's tasks.
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

These limits define when this provider is a poor fit or needs special
operational care. They are cur

rent package constraints, not a general OMP
comparison or a task backlog.

- **One fresh process and turn per run** — there is no continuation, resume,
pooling, progress strea

m, or OMP-session persistence (`--no-session`).
- **Static instance selection** — the Profile row fi

xes the provider name and
tool binding; calls cannot choose or change a model dynamically (the child

inherits whatever `~/.omp` binds).
- **Authentication and configuration remain native** — the Bundl

e spawns the
CLI but does not create accounts, log in, or rewrite OMP settings; a missing
API key or

unreachable provider surfaces as a child run failure with the
child's stderr tail as the diagnostic

.
- **The `omp` executable is required at delegation time** — resolution prefers
the npm package's b

in entry and falls back to `omp` on the harness host's
PATH; there is no bundled OMP payload.
- **Ru

ns are serialized** — a second delegation queues until the previous
child's run settles; parallel fa

n-out through this provider is not possible.
- **No human approval path** — the child runs with what

ever approval mode the
user's OMP configuration grants; this Bundle adds no interaction channel.
- *

*Assistant payload is the selected answer text only** — reasoning,
intermediate messages, tool traff

ic, and usage remain outside the parent
Session; failed runs expose a safe diagnostic instead.
- **N

o optional shared capabilities** — `agentPreset`, `agentOptions`, output
schemas, and harness depth

enforcement are rejected by the shared service
for this provider.
- **No wall-clock timeout beyond `

maxTime`** — the child is terminated at the
configured deadline, and files or external systems chang

ed before that point
are not restored.
## Install
### Method one: plugin market (Discover tab)

Once listed on awesome-dsh-plugin, search
for `dsh-subagent-omp` in the Harness plugin market (Plugi

ns → Discover) and
install it there.
### Method two: npm
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then point the Harness at the package directory, or install with the
`plugin_manager` tool:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

New npm releases are subject to the harness profile's fresh-release policy
(`minimumReleaseAge`); a

just-published version becomes installable about an
hour after publish.
### Method three: GitHub Release

Download the prebuilt tarball from the
Releases page and
install it with `plugin_manager` `install_b

undle` pointed at the `.tgz` file,
or pin the dependency in a profile `package.json` as a local `fil

e:` path
(`file:` entries get a lockfile integrity, URL entries do not).
### Development: local checkout

In the Harness plugin manager, choose "Install from directory" and select
this checkout; or `plugin_

manager` with `action: install_bundle` and the
absolute path of this directory.
## Configuration
The bundle exposes a settings entry (`subagent-omp`) with:
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `providerName` | `omp` | Registry name of the provider. |
| `maxTime` | `30m` | Whole-run deadline

passed to the child as `--max-time` (`<number>[s\|m\|h]`). |
| `env` | `{}` | Extra environment ent

ries merged onto the scrubbed parent environment. |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `3000` | Termination grace
for the managed child process. |
## Requirements

- An `omp` executable resolvable from the harness host (PATH or npm package).
- DeepSeek Harness `0.

2.2-rc.1` (the subagent seam is provided by the host;
runtime-only dependencies ship inside this bun

dle's `vendor/` tree so a
directory-linked install resolves everywhere).
